title: Community: Study Group Shenanigans
description: A study group at the world’s most chaotic community college.

questions.question: After the bar finds out his college degree is fake, lawyer Jeff Winger enrolls at what community college?
questions.explanation: Creator Dan Harmon based it on Glendale Community College, where he enrolled in his 30s to take a class with his girlfriend and fell in with a study group.

questions.question: At Greendale, Jeff poses as a tutor and invents a study group for which class, just to get closer to Britta?
questions.explanation: Jeff wanted a study group of two, but Britta invited a classmate and soon the whole table filled up. Their teacher: Ken Jeong's unhinged Señor Chang.

questions.question: In that Spanish study group, which film-obsessed member narrates their lives as if they were a TV show?
questions.explanation: Harmon based him on a real friend, Abed Gheith, who auditioned for the part and lost to Danny Pudi. Harmon later said he related to Abed more than to Jeff.

questions.question: Abed gets his action-movie dream when what campus-wide game, with priority registration as the prize, turns Greendale into a war zone?
questions.hint: Modern Warfare and A Fistful of Paintballs
questions.explanation: "Modern Warfare" (Season 1) was directed by Justin Lin of the Fast & Furious films. It was such a hit that the game returned for the two-part Season 2 finale.

questions.question: Between paintball wars, Abed insists a short-lived NBC superhero show will run for what, a line fans turned into Community's own battle cry?
choices: Troy and Abed in the morning
questions.hint: A prophecy about The Cape that fans adopted
questions.explanation: The show was NBC's The Cape, cancelled after one season. Community did get its six seasons (the last on Yahoo Screen); Peacock ordered the movie in 2022, and fans are still waiting.
